title: Racket Stringing Service Sync Freshness Gap
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stringing:service
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by player
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Shows which owners or feeds have stopped updating racket stringing service records inside the expected time window.
value: Admin workflows fall apart quietly when the feed goes stale, so a freshness check is the easiest way to keep the tracker trustworthy.
implementation: Set the freshness threshold to match how often the admin system or checklist should update.
visualization: Table of player values by hours since last racket stringing service update.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges when the records for racket stringing service have gone quiet and might no longer be reliable.
